mediator_selection: V14 fixed development error median seed; never reselect using V15 results.
architecture: Identical V10 plain two-head trainable core. Mediated actions are public-only frozen V14 inference, cached outside optimizer; raw/mediated core init and sampling matched. Motion_only independently trains original reference inputs. No branch head, no task-loss sweep.
input_contract: Public8x252 history, delayed4x6 relative context, original supplied GRU8x3 and raw proposed/anchor8x4x3. Mediated core sees frozen public estimated proposed/anchor commands; private command/execution/target/branch/valid/termination never network inputs. Raw commands kept for masks and original-cost scoring. No private mediator oracle.
loss: Unchanged group-balanced masked reference-motion MSE + anchored paired-response MSE + .001 energy; no resampling, no imputed future, no minimum predicted cost reward.
selection: Final80epoch. All3seeds reported, fixed ADE-median seed for each configuration; no best seed/epoch or fresh dev tuning.
normalization: V15 train public histories only with minimum std .01; frozen V14 mediator uses its original train normalizer.

decision_bootstrap.interpretation: Group-equal fresh-development descriptive percentile intervals; not untouched holdout.

later_required: Offline eligibility does not promote controller. Whole module off/failure equivalence, actual sequential/self-generated candidates, untouched holdout, original8Levels and new-scene closed-loop/safety/latency required.
